mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in less than 40% of observations when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (above 5.5%) signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of observations when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in less than 40% of observations when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending slowdown in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of observations during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL above 2.5%) compresses real earnings and triggers monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of observations when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate above 1,100,000 units signals strong residential construction and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in less than 40% of observations when HOUST > 1100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in less than 40% of observations when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle recoveries, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weak manufacturing activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of observations during early-cycle recoveries when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
